A genre that transcends time and space,  
With improvisation and swing,  
It moves us with its unique grace.

The blues and ragtime gave birth to it,  
Smooth jazz and cool jazz followed,  
Each style with its own distinct fit.

It''s a way of life, a way of being around.  

So let us dance and let us sing,  
Let us sway to the rhythm of the thing,  
For jazz is the music of the heart,  
A language that we all can start.'
